description:
A feature-rich desktop native client developed for Windows, MacOS, and Linux platforms, allowing you to enjoy the instant messaging service on your PC.


Important Note
1. The update is expected to be available in all regions within the next few days. The actual time of release may vary slightly depending on the region.
Compatibility & Installation
1. Added support for installing Synology Chat Client on Mac devices with Intel or Apple silicon processors.
Fixed Issues
1. Fixed an issue where certificate errors might be displayed when accessing Synology Chat Client through QuickConnect over HTTPS.
2. Fixed multiple security vulnerabilities.
